event.dedup: within (concept, dup_group): earliest year, then max n_refs, then min work_id (iteration-1 rule)

partners.source: legacy OpenAlex concept tags of the entry-year d-papers

nativeness.share: counts[d] / (total - unknown); truncated_top200 and d absent -> 0

co_transfer.companions: partners on c-papers with sub == o(c) in [e-5, e-1]
co_transfer.variant_any: partners on any earlier c-paper (years < e)

outcomes.prior_set: authors of c-papers in [e-5, e] plus their co-authors on any corpus work in [e-5, e]
outcomes.Y_strict: W2 d-papers of c with no author in Pset (papers without author ids excluded)
outcomes.Y_lenient: W2 d-papers with >= 1 author not in Pset
outcomes.EST_bin: Y_strict >= 3 and d-papers in >= 3 of the 5 W2 years

models.estimator: PPML (IRLS, exact sparse FE projection, singleton/separation pruning)
models.sample: screen fold, MAIN population, kw5, main arm (F <= e <= 2019)
models.coefficient_scale: IRR per 0.1 of A / CT and per SD
models.inference: CRV1 by concept (pyfixest small-sample factor); wild cluster score bootstrap p (999)

decision.GRAFTING: b_A > 0, Holm p < .05, b_CT not significantly > 0
decision.negative: a significant negative sign is reported as such

models.fallback_thin_cells: retained < 30% of events or G < 50 -> secondary spec co-primary

label.benchmark: median entry A over REFERENCE_ACCEPTED reference-arm events in d (>= 5), else field, else global

note: sha256 = sha256(json.dumps(spec, sort_keys=True)); frozen before stage 6 (outcomes) ran for the first time
